title: cleomella plocasperma var. mojavensis
intro: Cleomella plocasperma var. mojavensis, commonly known as Desert Cleome, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Desert Cleome include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
